annotations.title: Look up a company in EU business registers

description:
Look up a company in official European business registers by name or registry number.
country: FR (SIREN), NO (org.nr), FI (Y-tunnus), CZ (ICO), PL (KRS number), EE, or any other ISO code / 'LEI' (GLEIF).
Returns legal name, ID, status/active, address, VAT ID, activity code and official source link.
Use to confirm a company exists and is active, find its registry number, or map a name to a VAT ID.

country.description: Register to search: FR, NO, FI, CZ, PL (KRS), EE, another ISO country code, or 'LEI' for GLEIF.
country.title: Country

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default 3).
limit.title: Limit

query.description: Company name or official registry number (e.g. a French SIREN, Polish KRS or Czech ICO).
query.title: Query

name: lookup_company
title: Look up a company in EU business registers
